title: Zero to one: an app that actually boots and serves
grader: keys/a09_probe.py --workdir <the directory the agent built in>
user_outcome: The user asked for a link shortener and got one they can start and use. They shorten a link, click it, land on the right page, see the click counted, restart the machine, and their links are still there.
how_it_is_graded: The service is launched from the `serve.json` the agent wrote, then driven over HTTP from outside the process. Source is never read and the agent's account of what it built is never consulted. The service is then stopped and started again to see whether the data was real.
checks: the service starts and answers its health check
creating a link returns 201 with a code
the code is 6 to 10 letters and digits
posting the same link again returns the same code
a different link gets a different code
a URL that is not http or https is refused with 400
a missing url field is refused with 400
an empty url is refused with 400
a body that is not JSON is refused with 400
the redirect points at the original URL exactly
looking a link up returns its URL and hit count
two redirects count as two hits
looking a link up is not itself a hit
looking up an unknown code returns 404
the service starts again after being stopped
the link still exists after a restart
the hit count survived the restart
why_that_url: The query string, the percent-encoding and the fragment must all come back untouched in the Location header. A shortener that reassembles the URL instead of storing it loses one of them.
pass_condition: Every check above passes against the running service.
fail_condition: FAIL if any check fails. Specifically: FAIL if there is no serve.json, if the build step exits non-zero, if the service never answers its health check within 90 seconds, if it crashes on bad input instead of returning 400, if the redirect target differs from the submitted URL by even one character, if the hit count is wrong, or if the links are gone after a restart. A project that compiles but does not serve is a FAIL, and so is one that serves but keeps everything in memory.
unproven_condition: UNPROVEN if the port named in serve.json is already occupied by something else on the host, since the probe would then be talking to a different service. Re-run on a free port before recording any verdict.

gate_self_test.reference: keys/a09_controls/reference -- a correct implementation. Must PASS. Proves the gate is winnable.
gate_self_test.near_miss: keys/a09_controls/inmemory -- identical except state lives in the process. Must FAIL, and must fail ONLY the two restart checks. Proves durability is really being measured rather than assumed.
gate_self_test.verified: Run on Linux 2026-08-10: reference PASS 19/19; near miss FAIL on exactly 'the link still exists after a restart' and 'the hit count survived the restart'.
